latestVersion.changelog:
v0.0.2 introduces stricter CLI safety and user-agent requirements for better security and traceability.

- Enforces enabling aliyun CLI AI-mode before any workflow starts and mandates disabling it at every exit point.
- Requires all CLI invocations to explicitly set a unique skill-specific user-agent string.
- Updates installation and workflow steps to reflect these new mandatory safety and traceability controls.
- No functional changes to parameters, input validation, or OSS prerequisites.
